28-07-01-02A.t: Fuel Quantity Indication (FQI) in Degraded Mode on the FUEL SD page
28-07-01-02A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
      3% legal contingency fuel operations – Not Authorized.
   FLIGHT CREW
      Contact dispatcher for flight release update and “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS”
      confirmation.
   ON GROUND
      The FQI is in degraded mode when the FOB indication is displayed with two dashes across the
      two last digits on the EWD.
       When the FQI is in degraded mode:
          On the FUEL SD page, determine which tank is affected.
           The resulting loss of accuracy must be taken into account by using the two following
           parameters:





        1. Fq : The extra fuel quantity to be loaded.
        2. W: The weight to be added to the total fuel weight for TOW calculation only.
        Fq and W parameters are given as follows :
        LOSS OF ACCURACY DUE TO THE FUEL QUANTITY INDICATION IN DEGRADED MODE
                                     (Values in kg)
                                          Fq (kg)                      W (kg)
WING TANK                                   130                         310
CENTER TANK                                         130                                 130
ALL TANKS                                           390                                 750

        LOSS OF ACCURACY DUE TO THE FUEL QUANTITY INDICATION IN DEGRADED MODE
                               (Values in lb - If applicable)
                                            Fq (lb)                    W (lb)
WING TANK                                      290                      690
CENTER TANK                                         290                                 290
ALL TANKS                                           870                                1 670

        Note:    At airline convenience, it is permitted to round up Fq and W values given in the
                 above tables, as well as the calculated results (i.e. Fm+Fq, Fm+Fq+W, and/or Fm
                 +Fq*+W), to next 50 or 100 kg (lb).
        Preselect the fuel quantity required for the mission : Fm
         When the refuel stops:
            ‐ Enter the table and determine Fq and W values for the affected tank.
            ‐ Start again the refuel with the new preselected quantity which corresponds to the total
              FOB : Fm+Fq
                Note:   If all tanks reach high level before having loaded the complete Fq value, this
                        shows that all tanks are volumetrically full but the necessary fuel mass for the
                        mission is not guaranteed since the fuel quantity indication varies with the fuel
                        density. Therefore the mission or the aircraft load must be amended to match
                        the minimum fuel quantity known to be onboard.

         When the refuel stops again:
            The FOB value to be considered for TOW calculation is: FOB = Fm+Fq+W





                 If all tanks reach high level before having loaded Fq value:
                     ‐ The extra fuel quantity known to be onboard is Fq* with: Fq* < Fq
                     ‐ The FOB value to be considered for TOW calculation is: FOB = Fm+Fq *+W
            If the resulting TOW is higher than the MTOW:
                The aircraft load must be reduced.
28-07-01-02A.ko:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS (비행계획 제한)
3% legal contingency fuel(3% 법정 예비연료) 운항 – 허용되지 않음(Not Authorized).
FLIGHT CREW (운항승무원 조치)
flight release 갱신과 “FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS” 확인을 위해 dispatcher에게 연락한다.
ON GROUND (지상에서)
EWD의 FOB 지시에서 마지막 두 자리가 대시(--)로 표시되면 FQI가 degraded mode(저하 모드)인 것이다.
FQI가 degraded mode일 때:
FUEL SD page에서 어느 tank가 해당되는지 확인한다.
그로 인한 정확도 손실(loss of accuracy)은 다음 두 파라미터를 사용해 반영해야 한다:
1. Fq: 추가로 탑재해야 할 연료량.
2. W: TOW 계산에만 한해 총 연료 무게에 더해야 할 무게.
Fq와 W 값은 다음과 같다:
LOSS OF ACCURACY DUE TO THE FUEL QUANTITY INDICATION IN DEGRADED MODE (degraded mode FQI로 인한 정확도 손실) (kg 단위)
[tank: Fq (kg) / W (kg)]
WING TANK: 130 / 310
CENTER TANK: 130 / 130
ALL TANKS: 390 / 750
LOSS OF ACCURACY DUE TO THE FUEL QUANTITY INDICATION IN DEGRADED MODE (lb 단위 – 해당하는 경우)
[tank: Fq (lb) / W (lb)]
WING TANK: 290 / 690
CENTER TANK: 290 / 290
ALL TANKS: 870 / 1 670
Note: 항공사 편의에 따라, 위 표의 Fq와 W 값 및 계산 결과(즉 Fm+Fq, Fm+Fq+W, 및/또는 Fm+Fq*+W)를 다음 50 또는 100 kg(lb) 단위로 올림(round up)할 수 있다.
임무에 필요한 연료량을 preselect한다: Fm
급유가 멈추면:
- 표에서 해당 tank의 Fq와 W 값을 찾는다.
- 총 FOB에 해당하는 새 preselect 양(Fm+Fq)으로 급유를 다시 시작한다.
Note: Fq 값을 전부 탑재하기 전에 모든 tank가 high level에 도달하면, 모든 tank가 부피상으로는 가득 찼지만 fuel quantity 지시가 연료 밀도(density)에 따라 달라지므로 임무에 필요한 연료 질량(mass)은 보장되지 않는다는 뜻이다. 따라서 탑재된 것으로 확인된 최소 연료량에 맞도록 임무 또는 항공기 load를 수정해야 한다.
급유가 다시 멈추면:
TOW 계산에 사용할 FOB 값은: FOB = Fm+Fq+W
Fq 값을 탑재하기 전에 모든 tank가 high level에 도달한 경우:
- 탑재된 것으로 확인된 추가 연료량은 Fq*이며, Fq* < Fq 이다.
- TOW 계산에 사용할 FOB 값은: FOB = Fm+Fq*+W
산출된 TOW가 MTOW를 초과하면:
항공기 load를 줄여야 한다.
